Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

tidytmle 0.1.0

  • Initial release of tidytmle, a cross-fitted Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation (TMLE) orchestrator for the tidymodels ecosystem.
  • Added progressive-disclosure specification API (tmle_spec(), set_preprocessing(), set_outcome_learners(), set_treatment_learners(), set_censoring_learners(), set_resamples(), set_targeting()) accepting parsnip specs, workflows, and workflowsets::workflow_set objects.
  • Added role-aware recipes splitting (split_causal_recipes()), automatic informative-missingness modeling (C(A, W)), smart stratified/grouped rsample cross-fitting, and native hardhat case weights support.
  • Added bounded canonical logistic fluctuation, adaptive positivity truncation, joint EIF inference across "ate", "rr", "or", "ey1", "ey0", "att", and "atc", cluster-robust EIF SEs, simultaneous uniform confidence bands, and VanderWeele-Ding E-values.
  • Added instantaneous retarget() without ML refitting, shift() / scale_tx() Modified Treatment Policies, DR-Learner CATE estimation (fit_cate(), qini_auc()), and autoplot() diagnostics ("overlap", "learners", "eif", "sensitivity", "balance").

Developed by Michael Espero.
